papers_read.title_as_printed: Comparing a pre-defined versus deep learning approach for extracting brain atrophy patterns to predict cognitive decline due to Alzheimer's disease in patients with mild cognitive symptoms (Arvidsson et al., 2024)
Predictive value of ATN biomarker profiles in estimating disease progression in Alzheimer's disease dementia (Ezzati et al., Alzheimers Dement 2021, author manuscript)

what_each_reports.P-274: AUC 0.862 (CI 0.728-0.960) for four-year SCD/MCI-to-AD-dementia progression, clinical + hippocampal volume logistic model, BioFINDER-1 double CV (n=332); clinical-only 0.850; ADNI external subset similar except FreeSurfer (0.688) and DL (0.799).
what_each_reports.P-192: No AUC. For aMCI-to-dementia conversion in ADNI (n=415), CN-vs-dementia classifiers applied to MCI give sensitivity/specificity/PPV per horizon; RUSBoost biomarker model PPV 68% at 4 years vs observed 4-year incidence 22.2% (clinical feature set PPV 67.3%); sensitivity 61.5% and specificity 91.7% at 4 years.

quantity_a: Threshold-free ROC-AUC for four-year progression to CSF-confirmed AD dementia in memory-clinic SCD+MCI patients (BioFINDER-1), predictors clinical + hippocampal volume.
quantity_b: Positive predictive value at a fixed 0.5 cut-off of a CN-vs-dementia classifier applied to ADNI amnestic MCI, for all-cause clinical dementia diagnosis by 4 years (prevalence-dependent), predictors ATN biomarkers (CSF, amyloid PET, FDG PET) or clinical features.
incompatible_if_same: Not assessable: an AUC of 0.86 and a PPV of 68% at 22% incidence are not on a common scale; PPV depends on prevalence and threshold, AUC on neither, so no value of one excludes a value of the other.

gates.task: match in broad class (MCI-stage progression to dementia) but the outcome definitions differ (CSF-confirmed AD dementia vs clinical dementia not necessarily due to AD).
gates.validation_tier: mismatch: P-274 internal double CV with external ADNI check; P-192 cross-validated CN/dementia training then application to the MCI set within ADNI.
gates.modality_family: mismatch: clinical + structural MRI volume (P-274) vs PET/CSF biomarkers or clinical tests (P-192).

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: AUC vs PPV (different metric types); AD dementia with CSF confirmation vs all-cause dementia.
performance_validity: not a performance comparison that can be made; flag not tripped.
independence: Distinct studies and authors; P-274's small ADNI external subset may share participants with P-192, but P-274's headline estimate is BioFINDER.
grounds: P-274 reports a ROC-AUC while P-192 reports no AUC at all, only threshold-dependent sensitivity, specificity and PPV, so the metric types differ.
P-192's outcome is clinical dementia not necessarily due to AD in ADNI aMCI, whereas P-274's is CSF-confirmed AD dementia in BioFINDER SCD/MCI, so the endpoint and population differ.
Dataset family and modality gates both fail with no waiver on record.

evidence_quotes.quote: Adding intracranial and hippocampal volume to the clinical data model increased the test AUC to 0.862 (CI 0.728-0.960)
diagnosis of AD dementia was only used if the participant had an abnormal cerebrospinal fluid profile consistent with AD pathological change.
> 45% over 4 years (model's PPV = 68% vs. observed rate of dementia onset = 22.2%)
Sensitivity, specificity, PPV, and negative predictive value (NPV) for each model were calculated.
In the ADNI sample, MCI and dementia diagnosis was not necessarily due to AD

record_defects: claim_b 'P-192: PPV 68.0 on T2' is set against an AUC; the record's own resolution_note concedes 'Metric type unclear: AUC / Unknown'.
dataset_equal 'Yes' is wrong: P-274's cohort is BioFINDER-1; P-192's is ADNI.
modality_family 'clinical_survey' / modality_family_equal 'Yes' is wrong: P-274 uses structural MRI volume, P-192's headline PPV comes from the ATN biomarker feature set (PET/CSF).
gap_magnitude 0.18 subtracts a PPV from an AUC, which is meaningless.
what_would_change_the_verdict: An AUC from P-192 for the same four-year AD-dementia endpoint (it reports none) would be needed even to begin a comparison; dataset and modality would still differ.
